s: Who out of the following led the Ryot Agitation of Andhra in 1933?
Who among the following visited the Palnadu area in July 1921 to study the situation arising out of agitation against forest laws
x:
Unnava Lakshminarayana, the renowned freedom fighter and social reformer, visited the Palnadu region in July 1921 to study the impact of the people's agitation against the British forest laws. His observations highlighted the hardships faced by peasants and tribal communities because of colonial forest policies and contributed to greater public awareness of the issue.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (3).
